instruction: Navigate to the web-based extension generator and create a basic Chrome extension called "dev-tools v1.0.0". Leave the description empty, include only a background script and browser action functionality, then extract the generated archive to "~/Projects".

metadata.explanation: Task variation 0: Creates a Chrome extension named 'dev-tools v1.0.0' using webext.eu. Evaluator validates manifest.json structure (name, version, background scripts, browser_action) and verifies all required files exist (manifest.json, background_script.js, browserAction files). Score: 50% for file existence + 50% for manifest structure validation.

llm_judge_reasons: Complete coverage: All instruction requirements are verified (extension name, version, background script, browser action, extraction location)
Correct getter logic: Reads manifest.json from correct path, checks all required files exist, proper JSON parsing with error handling
Correct metric logic: Properly navigates nested manifest keys, compares values correctly, balanced scoring (50% files + 50% manifest)
Data flow correctness: Getter extracts the right state (manifest + file existence), metric processes it correctly, expected values match instruction
Correct parameter handling: Metric directly accesses expected.get('manifest_checks') without incorrectly trying expected.get('rules'), which is correct for type='rule'
Semantic alignment: Evaluator can accurately determine if the Chrome extension was created correctly with all required components
